name: Text Classifier
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Text Classifier node to classify (categorize) incoming data. Using the categories provided in the parameters (see below), each item is passed to the model to determine its category

parameters.name: Input Prompt
parameters.description: defines the input to classify. This is usually an expression that references a field from the input items. For example, this could be {{ $json.chatInput }} if the input is a chat trigger. By default it references the text field

parameters.name: Categories
parameters.description: Add the categories that you want to classify your input as. Categories have a name and a description. Use the description to tell the model what the category means. This is important if the meaning isn't obvious. You can add as many categories as you like

parameters.name: Allow Multiple Classes To Be True
parameters.description: You can configure the classifier to always output a single class per item (turned off), or allow the model to select multiple classes (turned on)

parameters.name: When No Clear Match
parameters.description: Define what happens if the model can't find a good match for an item. There are two options:

parameters.name: System Prompt Template
parameters.description: Use this option to change the system prompt that's used for the classification. It uses the {categories} placeholder for the categories

parameters.name: Enable Auto-Fixing
parameters.description: When enabled, the node automatically fixes model outputs to ensure they match the expected format. Do this by sending the schema parsing error to the LLM and asking it to fix it

parameters.name: inputText
parameters.description: Use an expression to reference data in previous nodes or enter static text

parameters.name: confidenceScoresNotice
parameters.displayName: Confidence scores are estimates from the model, not measured probabilities. They can change between runs, so treat them as a rough signal, not a threshold.

options.name: fallback
options.description: What to do with items that don’t match the categories exactly

options.name: includeConfidenceScores
options.description: Whether to add a classification field to each item with the model's confidence score for every category

options.name: systemPromptTemplate
options.description: String to use directly as the system prompt template

options.name: enableAutoFixing
options.description: Whether to enable auto-fixing (may trigger an additional LLM call if output is broken)

options.name: batching
options.description: Batch processing options for rate limiting
